title: A Stone to Stand On
description: Find a waystone out in the world and attune it by using it.

giver.name: Journal
giver.text: Wind, grass, open sky. No walls, no lanterns. This is the survival world, and everything in it is yours to find. First, though, something to hold on to.

rewards.hint: Waystones stand in villages (by the bell), at dungeon entrances and in Wayshrines.
